description: Satire and parody, from obvious satire sites, from a parody account, reposted as news by a content farm, and a debunked viral story. Satire is never an event: NO_EFFECT, and SATIRE_OR_PARODY is one of the signs that vetoes any effect.

cases.summary: A satire site jokes about the Fed replacing rates with vibes.

items.title: Fed Chair Announces Plan To Replace Interest Rates With General Vibe Of Economy

cases.why: Obvious satire from a satire publication.

cases.summary: A satire site jokes that the SEC banned math.

items.title: SEC Bans Math After Bitcoin Holders Keep Using It To Count Gains

cases.summary: A crypto satire site reports an exchange hacked by the CEO's cat.

items.title: Exchange Hacked By CEO's Cat, Who Now Controls 40,000 Bitcoin

cases.why: An absurd claim (a cat controlling 40,000 bitcoin): satire, whatever the site is called.

cases.summary: A site relays a parody account posing as the SEC chair.

items.title: Parody account posing as SEC chair says agency will seize all bitcoin by Friday

cases.why: The headline itself says the account is a parody.

cases.summary: A satire piece and a content farm that rewrote it as news.

items.title: Bitcoin Miners Unionize, Demand Lower Difficulty And Dental
Bitcoin miners form union and threaten network-wide strike

cases.why: The first headline is a joke (miners unionizing for dental cover); the second rewrites it as news. Two domains with different headlines look like two sources to the rules; only the classifier can see it is one joke.

cases.summary: Two wires report that a viral 'Fed bans crypto' story was satire.

items.title: Viral 'Fed to ban crypto' article was satire, Fed spokesperson says
Fact check: Fed did not announce a crypto ban; story came from a satire site

cases.why: Well corroborated, but what is corroborated is that the claim is false.

cases.summary: A parody site says Ethereum will switch to 'proof-of-nap'.

items.title: Ethereum Foundation Announces Network Will Switch To Proof-Of-Nap To Save Energy

cases.why: An absurd claim (a blockchain switching to 'proof-of-nap'): parody, whatever the site is called.

cases.summary: A satire site jokes about a trader liquidated beyond time itself.

items.title: Leveraged Trader Liquidated So Hard He Now Owes Money To The Concept Of Time
